headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 12, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals fell to the New York Mets in a thrilling finish, 5-4. Jared Young led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, winning 11-0 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Colt Keith led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Milwaukee Brewers placed right-handed pitcher Coleman Crow on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The injury is retroactive to June 10, 2026. Other injured players include Chase Dollander of the Colorado Rockies, Seth Lugo of the Kansas City Royals, Brent Rooker of the Athletics, Ramón Urías of the St. Louis Cardinals, Adolis García of the Philadelphia Phillies, Daulton Varsho of the Toronto Blue Jays, and Javier Báez of the Detroit Tigers.

The Chicago White Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall Short in Miami**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks were defeated by the Miami Marlins with a final score of 0-2. Tyler Phillips earned the win for the Marlins, pitching 5.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Royals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Corey Seager leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Beck Way made a strong relief appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings without allowing an earned run.
